notes: All 62 available leaves in the requested printed range were visually surveyed. Available distinct cuts, ornaments, decorated initials, construction pieces and pictorial symbols have been revived. Ordinary text, numerals and calendar tables are excluded. Duplicate compositions and unobserved components are documented in the family inventories. Printed pages 217–218 are absent from this scan; this is not a claim to have recovered those pages.
